run_llvm_rl_training: run the LLVM RL training loop using Hydra config and the Model class
run_llvm_rl_testing: run the LLVM RL test evaluation after training using the Model class
get_hydra_job_id: get the current Hydra job ID defaulting to zero in single run mode
review_train_entry_point: review the train.py entry point that uses Hydra config to create and train a Model
refactor_model_validation: refactor the train.py main function to handle Model validation errors with custom logic
